rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kayış, the malevolent old-man ghoul whose own legs are living leather straps binding a road traveller.
ANATOMY: Exactly ONE old-man ghoul, one old head, two normal eyes, TWO arms and hands. His entire lower body consists of EXACTLY TWO broad long flat leathery legs with NO FEET. The root of EACH strap-leg visibly emerges from its own side of his hips beneath a short ragged opaque tunic: show both hip-to-strap transitions, uncovered leathery tissue continuing seamlessly from the hip into each ribbon-shaped leg. These two legs hang down the FRONT of ONE adult male traveller, then coil tightly around that traveller's waist. No trousers or conventional thighs on the ghoul; no buckles, belt hardware, belts, straps worn as clothes, harnesses, ropes or binding accessories anywhere. Traveller has one head, two eyes, two arms, two ordinary legs, plainly opaque clothes. [kay-s-c01, kay-s-c02, kay-s-c03, kay-s-c04, kay-s-c05]
MOMENT: CLING to the traveller's neck from above, old ghoul leans forward glaring straight at viewer, both hands clutching the traveller's shoulders; traveller twists and strains to pull away. The ghoul's two autonomous strap-legs visibly tighten like muscular appendages, their uninterrupted paths from hips to waist coils clearly readable.
POWER: The ghoul rides a person's neck, wraps its own leathery legs round the person's waist and refuses release, forcing the person to carry it. Physical binding only; no invented magical effects. [kay-s-c02, kay-s-c03, kay-s-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: Low frontal three-quarter close framing from the traveller's upper thighs to ghoul's head. Ghoul occupies top two thirds; exposed leg origins sit just above the traveller's shoulders on BOTH sides, two broad descending leather ribbons contrast clearly against traveller's light coarse tunic. Victim leans sideways, never blocking either leg origin. Ghoul hips and all waist coils must be inside frame. No giant scale variant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE cold moonbeam from upper side catches leathery hip-to-leg transitions and enraged old face, hard rim light, deep walnut shadows, damp night mist over the water.
SURFACE: Deep wrinkles, tangled gray hair, cracked weathered organic leather grain on living legs, coarse opaque brown ghoul tunic, coarse light traveller cloth, wet gravel. Not plastic.
SETTING: Night road beside a dark river; faint water reflection behind the clearly foregrounded ghoul and traveller. [kay-s-c04, kay-s-c08]
MOOD: Malevolent, suffocating, dangerous and imposing, a supernatural living anatomy revealed mid-attack. Never ordinary elderly rider, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native square PNG at least 1024x1024. No text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, glowing eyes or floating runes. The two leather appendages are anatomical LEGS, never wardrobe belts. Claim labels are instructions, not visible text.

Road next to river after dark.

Opaque clothes, leathery hip transitions, camera angle, moonbeam, exact composition and dark warm colors are editorial choices to reveal documented strap legs; not extra powers.
